title: WHAT IF YOUR SHADOW MOVED ON ITS OWN?

segments.line: Detach. It flips the light off across the room.
Detach. It waves at Mo without being
What if your shadow could move on its own?
One catch: your shadow's just a hole in the light. On
the Moon, its edge sweeps by at thirteen times light speed.
So where does it go at night?

shots.note: night, lamp on: Pip sits up in bed and points at the dresser; the DETACH chip blinks
his black silhouette peels off the floor and walks toward the dresser under the window
the shadow's mitten lifts the remote off the dresser among the plant and the speaker

shots.line: Detach. It flips the light off across the room.
shots.note: the shadow reaches the nightstand lamp and pulls it dark; the room falls to moonlight

shots.line: Detach. It waves at Mo without being
shots.note: Mo leans in at the lit doorway waving; the shadow on the floor waves back first
Pip, uneasy in the moonlight, looks from the wave to Mo

shots.line: What if your shadow could move on its own?
shots.note: the title over Pip and his shadow standing side by side on the moonlit floor

shots.line: One catch: your shadow's just a hole in the light. On
shots.note: A SHADOW IS A HOLE IN THE LIGHT: rays part around a blocker icon; NO PHOTONS, NO MASS

shots.line: the Moon, its edge sweeps by at thirteen times light speed.
shots.note: the beam lands on the Moon, 384,400 km; a hand flick sweeps 1 radian in 0.1 s; the counter climbs to 12.8x light speed
That's real: Pip, worried, the rims cooling toward red

shots.line: So where does it go at night?
shots.note: the shadow, taller now, waves on its own behind still Pip, then walks out through the door and fades into the hall light
